cards.name: SymbolDefinition
cards.summary: The master artwork of a symbol. One definition lives in a symbol library (the document's local library, or a linked external .csl library), and every instance placed on a page draws it, so editing the definition updates every instance at once.
use_for: a logo, icon or seat/table marker repeated many times in a layout, where one edit must update every copy
keeping file size down when the same artwork repeats on many pages
checking linked library symbols for broken or out-of-date links before a file is handed off
avoid: art that must look different in each place: instances share one definition; use plain copies or groups, or revert one instance with Symbol.RevertToShapes
editing a definition that comes from an external library: it is linked, so BreakLink first or edit the source .csl
cards.how: Coclass; its members live on IVGSymbolDefinition. Get it from a library with ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols("Name") (local) or Application.SymbolLibraries(i).Symbols(...) (external), or from a placed instance with Shape.Symbol.Definition. Create one by converting art with Shape.ConvertToSymbol / ShapeRange.ConvertToSymbol("Name"); place instances with Layer.CreateSymbol(x, y, "Name").

key_members.name: Name
key_members.use: get / set the symbol's name (the key used by Symbols("...") and Layer.CreateSymbol)

key_members.name: Description
key_members.use: free-text description shown in the Symbols docker

key_members.name: Editable
key_members.use: True when the definition can be changed (test before editing)

key_members.name: EnterEditMode
key_members.use: open the definition for editing, like double-clicking an instance

key_members.name: InstanceCount
key_members.use: how many instances the active document holds

key_members.name: Linked
key_members.use: True when it comes from an external library

key_members.name: IsLinkUpdated
key_members.use: the external library has a newer version

key_members.name: UpdateLinks
key_members.use: pull the newer version from the external library

key_members.name: FixLink
key_members.use: re-point a broken link to a library path

key_members.name: BreakLink
key_members.use: turn a linked definition into a local one

key_members.name: Duplicate
key_members.use: copy the definition under a new name

key_members.name: Copy
key_members.use: copy to the clipboard (paste into another document with SymbolLibrary.Paste)

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: remove the definition from its library

gotchas: EnterEditMode switches the document into symbol-edit mode; always call LeaveEditMode afterwards, or the user is left inside the symbol editor (unverified what ActiveLayer points to while editing).
Linked definitions are not editable in place: check Editable, or BreakLink first (unverified that Editable is False for every linked symbol).
InstanceCount and Instances look at the current document only, not every open document.
Delete with instances still on the page may fail or take the instances with it (unverified); check InstanceCount first.
Sprite and Button types (cdrSymbolType) are legacy web/animation symbol types; ordinary symbols are cdrSymbolTypeSymbol (unverified: the type library only names the three values).
cards.example:
Set sh = ActiveSelectionRange.ConvertToSymbol("Logo")
Set def = sh.Symbol.Definition
def.Description = "Brand mark master"
ActiveLayer.CreateSymbol 2, 2, "Logo"
Debug.Print def.Name, def.InstanceCount, def.Linked
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: marked the Sprite/Button 'legacy' claim unverified (the type library only names the values)

cards.name: SymbolDefinitions
cards.summary: A read-only list of symbol definitions: all the symbols in one library (SymbolLibrary.Symbols) or the sub-symbols nested inside one symbol (SymbolDefinition.NestedSymbols). Look a symbol up by index or name, or walk them all.
use_for: listing every symbol in a document for an asset audit or a cleanup script
finding a symbol by name before placing it with Layer.CreateSymbol
checking which nested symbols a complex symbol depends on
avoid: creating symbols: there is no Add here; use ShapeRange.ConvertToSymbol or SymbolLibrary.Paste
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGSymbolDefinitions. Returned by IVGSymbolLibrary.Symbols (ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols for the local library) and IVGSymbolDefinition.NestedSymbols. Iterate with Count / Item or For Each.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one IVGSymbolDefinition by index or by name (IndexOrName)

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of definitions in the list

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the list

gotchas: Item accepts a name or an index; an unknown name probably raises an error rather than returning Nothing (unverified), so loop and compare Name when unsure.
Index base is not stated in the type library; CorelDRAW collections are normally base 1 (unverified here).
The list is read-only: no Add / Remove; deleting goes through SymbolDefinition.Delete or SymbolLibrary.PurgeUnusedSymbols.
cards.example:
For Each d In ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols
    Debug.Print d.Name, d.InstanceCount, d.Linked
Next d
Set logo = ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary.Symbols.Item("Logo")
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: SymbolLibraries
cards.summary: The external symbol libraries (.csl files) listed in the Symbols docker (Application.SymbolLibraries). A script can add one library file or a whole folder of them, then reach each library's symbols.
use_for: loading a brand's shared icon library before a layout script places icons
registering a folder of .csl libraries on a new workstation
finding which library a linked symbol comes from
avoid: the document's own symbols: those are in ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary, not in this collection
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGSymbolLibraries. Reach it with Application.SymbolLibraries. Add(FileName, CopyLocally) adds one .csl and returns its IVGSymbolLibrary; AddFromFolder(Folder, Recursive, CopyLocally) adds every library in a folder and returns how many were added.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one IVGSymbolLibrary by index or name

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the libraries

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add one .csl library file; CopyLocally (default False) presumably copies the file into the local library folder instead of using it in place (unverified)

key_members.name: AddFromFolder
key_members.use: add all libraries in a folder, optionally recursive; returns the count added

gotchas: Adding a library changes the Symbols docker for later sessions too (unverified that it persists).

With CopyLocally = False the library is presumably used in place, so symbols placed from it can break (SymbolDefinition.IsLinkBroken) if the .csl is moved later (unverified: the type library does not describe CopyLocally).
Which name Item("...") matches (library Name vs file name) is not stated (unverified); compare SymbolLibrary.Name or FilePath in a loop to be safe.
cards.example:
Set libs = Application.SymbolLibraries
Set lib = libs.Add("D:\Brand\icons.csl", False)
Debug.Print libs.Count, lib.Name, lib.Symbols.Count
n = libs.AddFromFolder("D:\Brand\Symbols", True)
Debug.Print n & " libraries added"
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: CopyLocally meaning was stated as fact; the type library gives only the name, so marked unverified in Add and the gotcha

cards.name: SymbolLibrary
cards.summary: One symbol library: either the local library inside a document (ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary), which holds that file's symbol definitions, or an external .csl library from Application.SymbolLibraries. It gives the library's symbols, name, path and read-only state.
use_for: purging unused symbols from a template before handing it off
placing icons from a shared library with Layer.CreateSymbol(x, y, name, library)
copying a symbol between documents: SymbolDefinition.Copy, then Paste into the target document's library
avoid: deleting the local library: Delete works on external libraries only
writing to a library whose ReadOnly is True
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGSymbolLibrary. Local: ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary. External: Application.SymbolLibraries(i) or the return value of SymbolLibraries.Add. Symbols lists its IVGSymbolDefinition objects.

key_members.name: FilePath
key_members.use: full path of the library file

key_members.name: ReadOnly
key_members.use: True when the library cannot be changed

key_members.name: PurgeUnusedSymbols
key_members.use: remove symbols the current document does not use (local library only)

key_members.name: Paste
key_members.use: paste a symbol from the clipboard into this library, optionally renamed (local library only)

gotchas: PurgeUnusedSymbols and Paste work on the local library only; Delete works on external libraries only (stated in the type library).
Whether Delete on an external library also deletes the .csl file on disk or only removes it from the list is not stated (unverified); assume the file may go.

To place a symbol from an external library pass the library as the 4th argument of Layer.CreateSymbol; without it the name is presumably looked up in the local library (unverified; Library defaults to 0 / Nothing).
cards.example:
Set loc = ActiveDocument.SymbolLibrary
loc.PurgeUnusedSymbols
Debug.Print loc.Name, loc.Symbols.Count
Set ext = Application.SymbolLibraries.Item(1)
ActiveLayer.CreateSymbol 1, 1, ext.Symbols.Item(1).Name, ext
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: local-library fallback of CreateSymbol marked unverified

cards.name: SystemPrinters
cards.summary: The printers installed in Windows, as CorelDRAW's print engine sees them (Application.Printers), plus the system default printer. Each entry is a printer object with its name, port, PostScript and colour capability.
use_for: choosing a PostScript-capable proof printer from a script before PrintOut
preflighting that the expected proof or plotter printer is installed before an automated print run
avoid: setting the job's printer by name: Document.PrintSettings.SelectPrinter(Name) is simpler
cards.how: Coclass from the print engine (also in CdrPrn); members live on IPrnVBAPrinters. Reach it with Application.Printers. Item(n) and Default return IPrnVBAPrinter objects (Name, Port, Ready, PostScriptEnabled, ColorEnabled ...); assign one to ActiveDocument.PrintSettings.Printer.
gotchas: Item takes a numeric index only (no name lookup) and the collection has no _NewEnum, so use a For i = 1 To Count loop rather than For Each (base 1 unverified).
The list is read when you ask; network printers that are offline may still be listed (check IPrnVBAPrinter.Ready) (unverified).
cards.example:
Set ps = Application.Printers
For i = 1 To ps.Count
    Debug.Print ps.Item(i).Name, ps.Item(i).PostScriptEnabled
Next i
Set ActiveDocument.PrintSettings.Printer = ps.Default
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: Text
cards.summary: The text of one artistic or paragraph text shape (Shape.Text): its type, the whole story across linked frames, its frames, overflow state, find / replace, import / export and conversion between artistic and paragraph text.
use_for: template fill: replace placeholder copy in poster, flyer or certificate text
detecting overflowing paragraph frames before export, then shrinking the text to fit
converting a headline between artistic and paragraph text, or fitting it to a path
avoid: character-level formatting: use Story (an IVGTextRange) or Range(...) for font, size, colour
non-text shapes: Shape.Text is only meaningful when Shape.Type is a text shape
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGText. Reach it with Shape.Text on a text shape, e.g. after Layer.CreateArtisticText or Layer.CreateParagraphText. Story is the full text as an IVGTextRange; Range(Start, End) a slice; Frame / Frames the paragraph-text frames.

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: cdrArtisticText, cdrParagraphText or the fitted-to-path variants

key_members.name: Story
key_members.use: all text in all linked frames as an IVGTextRange

key_members.name: Contents
key_members.use: plain text string; Frames argument picks this frame / from here / all frames

key_members.name: Selection
key_members.use: the text selected in the editor, as a range

key_members.name: FramesInLink
key_members.use: number of frames in the linked chain

key_members.name: Overflow
key_members.use: True when text does not fit the chain of frames

key_members.name: FitTextToFrame
key_members.use: resize the text so it fits the frame

key_members.name: Find
key_members.use: find a string; returns its position

key_members.name: FitToPath
key_members.use: fit the text to a path shape; returns the effect

key_members.name: FontProperties
key_members.use: font properties as a structure, per frame scope

key_members.name: ImportFromFile
key_members.use: insert text from a file at a position

key_members.name: ExportToFile
key_members.use: write a range of the text to a file

gotchas: Contents and the *Properties members default to Frames = cdrAllFrames (2): on a linked chain you read/write the whole story; pass cdrThisFrameOnly (0) for one frame.
Overflow, FramesInLink and FitTextToFrame only make sense for paragraph text; check Type first.
Replace with ReplaceAll = False changes only the first match from StartIndex; pass ReplaceAll True for all.
FitTextToFrame changes the point size of the text, so a fixed type scale is lost.
Whether Range / Find character positions start at 0 or 1 is not stated; Find's StartIndex defaults to 1, so assume base 1 there (unverified for Range).
cards.example:
Set s = ActiveLayer.CreateParagraphText(1, 6, 5, 2, "Summer Sale")
Set t = s.Text
t.Story.Font = "Arial"
t.Story.Size = 36
t.Replace "Summer", "Winter", False
If t.Overflow Then t.FitTextToFrame
Debug.Print t.Type, t.Contents
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextCharacters
cards.summary: The characters of a text range (TextRange.Characters), each returned as its own one-character TextRange, so a script can style letters one by one (colour cycling, per-letter rotation or baseline shift).
use_for: rainbow or alternating-colour headline letters
playful per-letter rotation / bounce on a kids' poster title
enlarging the first letter of a story without a drop-cap effect
avoid: styling words or lines: TextWords / TextLines are simpler
whole-range formatting: set it on the TextRange directly, it is much faster than a per-character loop
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextCharacters. Reach it with Shape.Text.Story.Characters (or any TextRange.Characters). Item(Index, Count) returns a TextRange covering Count characters from Index.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of characters, including paragraph breaks

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: a TextRange of Count characters starting at Index

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: the first character as a TextRange

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: the last character as a TextRange

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the characters

gotchas: Count includes paragraph breaks (stated), so a loop also visits break characters; skip them when colouring.
Index base is not stated for characters; sibling collections (TextWords, TextFrames) are base 1 (unverified here).
Inserting or deleting text inside the loop shifts later indexes; collect first or walk backwards.
VertShift / HorizShift are whole numbers; they are believed to be a percentage of the point size (unverified).
cards.example:
Set ch = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Characters
For i = 1 To ch.Count
    ch.Item(i).CharAngle = (i Mod 2) * 10
    ch.Item(i).VertShift = (i Mod 3) * 10
Next i
ch.First.Size = 72
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextColumns
cards.summary: The text that falls in each column of a multi-column paragraph text frame (TextRange.Columns), each column returned as a TextRange, so a script can read or format column by column.
use_for: reading which copy landed in each column of a newsletter or brochure frame
formatting the text of one column differently (e.g. a sidebar column)
checking whether the last column is nearly empty before export
avoid: creating or resizing columns: that is TextFrame.SetColumns, not this collection
artistic text: it has no columns
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextColumns. Reach it with Shape.Text.Story.Columns (TextRange.Columns). Item(Index, Count) returns the text of Count columns from Index as one TextRange.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of columns the range spans

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of the given column(s), base 1

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the columns

gotchas: The type library text for Item says 'specified word'; that is a copy-paste slip, Item returns a column's text.
Columns follow the current layout: changing font size or frame width reflows text between columns, so re-read after edits.
Column count and widths are read from TextFrame (ColumnCount, ColumnWidth), not from here.
cards.example:
Set cols = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Columns
Debug.Print cols.Count
For i = 1 To cols.Count
    Debug.Print i, cols.Item(i).Length
Next i
cols.Last.Italic = True
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextFrame
cards.summary: One frame of a paragraph text chain: its text, its place in the chain (previous / next), vertical alignment, columns, links to other frames, container or path, and its own background fill.
use_for: flowing a long article from one frame into the next on a brochure spread (LinkTo)
setting three equal columns on a newsletter frame
centering copy vertically in a fixed-size badge or button frame
giving a text frame its own background colour
avoid: formatting characters: use the frame's Range (an IVGTextRange) or Text.Story
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextFrame. Reach it with Shape.Text.Frame (the shape's own frame) or Shape.Text.Frames.Item(i) / .First / .Last. FrameShape returns the text shape hosting the frame.

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: the text in this frame as an IVGTextRange

key_members.name: Empty
key_members.use: no text has flowed into this frame

key_members.name: SetColumns
key_members.use: create columns: count, equal widths, widths-and-gutters array

key_members.name: LinkTo
key_members.use: flow overflow text into another shape

key_members.name: UnLink
key_members.use: break the chain at this frame

key_members.name: FrameShape
key_members.use: the text shape that hosts this frame

key_members.name: Container
key_members.use: the container shape when text is placed inside an object

key_members.name: Path
key_members.use: the path shape for fitted text

gotchas: SetColumns' WidthsAndGutters array layout (width, gutter pairs per column) and whether it is ignored when EqualColumns is True are not stated (unverified).
Fill is the frame background, not the character colour; character colour is Range.Fill.
ColumnWidth / ColumnGutter take a column index whose base is not stated (unverified).
LinkTo expects a shape that can hold text (an empty paragraph frame or a closed object); other shapes probably raise an error (unverified).
cards.example:
Set a = ActiveLayer.CreateParagraphText(1, 10, 4, 6, Replace(Space(300), " ", "text "))
Set b = ActiveLayer.CreateParagraphText(5, 10, 8, 6, "")
a.Text.Frame.LinkTo b
a.Text.Frame.VerticalAlignment = cdrCenterJustify
a.Text.Frame.Fill.UniformColor.RGBAssign 255, 240, 200
Debug.Print a.Text.Frame.IsLast, b.Text.Frame.Index
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

review.changes: example filled the frame with one 800-character word (String repeats one character, no spaces), which may not wrap and flow; now 300 real words so LinkTo visibly flows

cards.name: TextFrames
cards.summary: The frames of a paragraph text chain (Text.Frames), or the frames a text range touches (TextRange.Frames). Walk them to find empty or overflowing frames, or get the text of a run of frames.
use_for: removing empty trailing frames after copy was shortened
listing which frame of a multi-page article holds which text
getting the text of frames 2-3 as one range
avoid: single-frame text: Text.Frame is enough
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextFrames. Reach it with Shape.Text.Frames or TextRange.Frames. Item / First / Last return IVGTextFrame objects; Range(Index, Count) and All return the text as an IVGTextRange.

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: the first frame (an IVGTextFrame, not a range)

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: text of Count frames from Index as a TextRange

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: text of every frame as a TextRange

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the frames

gotchas: Unlike TextWords / TextLines, First and Last here return frames, not text ranges; use Range or All for text.
TextRange.Frames lists only the frames that range spans, not the whole chain.
Deleting a frame's shape while iterating with For Each changes the chain; collect the shapes first, then delete.
cards.example:
Set fr = ActiveShape.Text.Frames
For Each f In fr
    Debug.Print f.Index, f.Empty, f.FrameShape.Name
Next f
If fr.Last.Empty Then fr.Last.FrameShape.Delete
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextIndentLevelStyle
cards.summary: The bullet or numbering style of one list indent level in paragraph text (multi-level lists): bullet character or number scheme, its font, size, baseline shift, number format and the indent of the bullet area.
use_for: numbered steps (1., 2., 3.) or Roman-numeral sections in a brochure or manual
nested bullet lists with a different bullet per level
matching a brand's custom bullet glyph and size
avoid: simple single-level bullets: TextRange.ApplyBulletEffect with BulletSymbol / BulletFont is enough
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextIndentLevelStyle. Reach it through a range: Shape.Text.Story.IndentLevelStyles.Item(n). Set a paragraph's level with TextRange.IndentLevel and switch the list on with TextRange.ApplyBulletEffect.

key_members.name: Level
key_members.use: which indent level this style describes

key_members.name: NumberStyle
key_members.use: cdrTextIndentLevelStyle scheme: bullet, Roman, Latin letters, other scripts

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: number format with prefix / suffix around the bullet placeholder

key_members.name: Font
key_members.use: font of the bullet or number

key_members.name: UseParagraphFont
key_members.use: use the paragraph's own font for the number

key_members.name: BaselineShift
key_members.use: vertical shift of the bullet in points

key_members.name: FirstCharIndent
key_members.use: width of the bullet / number area

key_members.name: FirstCharIndentIncludesBullet
key_members.use: whether that width includes the bullet

gotchas: Format uses a placeholder for the bullet/number, but the placeholder token is not given in the type library (unverified); read Format on a list made in the UI to see it.
Symbol only matters for the bullet scheme (cdrTextIndentLevelStyleBullet); numeric schemes ignore it (unverified).
The base of IndentLevelStyles.Item and of Level (0 or 1) is not stated (unverified).
Size and BaselineShift are in points; FirstCharIndent is a length in document units (unverified).
cards.example:
Set r = ActiveShape.Text.Story
r.ApplyBulletEffect
Set lv = r.IndentLevelStyles.Item(1)
lv.NumberStyle = cdrTextIndentLevelStyleUppercaseRomanNumeral
lv.UseParagraphFont = True
r.Paragraphs.Item(2).IndentLevel = 2
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextIndentLevelStyles
cards.summary: The list styles of every indent level available to a text range (TextRange.IndentLevelStyles), one TextIndentLevelStyle per level of a multi-level bullet or numbered list.
use_for: setting bullet glyphs for all levels of a nested list in one loop
reading the list setup of a template paragraph before copying it
avoid: setting which level a paragraph is on: that is TextRange.IndentLevel
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextIndentLevelStyles. Reach it with Shape.Text.Story.IndentLevelStyles (any IVGTextRange).

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the levels

gotchas: The styles belong to the paragraphs in the range; a range spanning differently styled paragraphs may report the first paragraph's styles (unverified).
Item base (0 or 1) is not stated (unverified); compare TextIndentLevelStyle.Level.
cards.example:
For Each lv In ActiveShape.Text.Story.IndentLevelStyles
    lv.NumberStyle = cdrTextIndentLevelStyleBullet
    lv.Symbol = ChrW(8226)
    Debug.Print lv.Level, lv.Size
Next lv
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextLines
cards.summary: The lines of a text range as they are currently laid out (TextRange.Lines), each returned as a TextRange, so a script can style the first line, check the last line, or count lines to fit copy.
use_for: small caps or bold lead-in on the first line of an article
spotting a widow (a last line with one short word) before export
counting lines to check that copy fits a fixed layout
avoid: logical units: line breaks move whenever text reflows; use TextParagraphs or TextWords for stable units
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextLines. Reach it with Shape.Text.Story.Lines (TextRange.Lines). Item(Index, Count) returns Count lines from Index as one TextRange.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: a TextRange of Count lines starting at Index

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the lines

gotchas: Lines depend on the current layout: changing font, size, spacing or frame width reflows the text, so re-read Lines after every formatting change.
Styling the first line (e.g. making it larger) can push words to the next line; the range you held no longer matches a visual line.
Whether a line range includes its trailing space or break is not stated (unverified); Trim before comparing text.
cards.example:
Set ln = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Lines
Debug.Print ln.Count
ln.First.Case = cdrSmallCapsFontCase
If ln.Last.Words.Count < 2 Then
    ActiveShape.Text.Story.CharSpacing = -5
End If
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextParagraphs
cards.summary: The paragraphs of a text range (TextRange.Paragraphs), each returned as a TextRange, so a script can format headline, body and caption paragraphs of one text object differently.
use_for: styling the first paragraph as a headline and the rest as body copy
setting space-after on every paragraph of a menu or price list
applying a paragraph style to selected paragraphs
avoid: character runs inside a paragraph: use TextWords / TextCharacters or TextRange.Range
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextParagraphs. Reach it with Shape.Text.Story.Paragraphs (TextRange.Paragraphs). Item(Index, Count) returns Count paragraphs from Index as one TextRange.

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: a TextRange of Count paragraphs starting at Index

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the paragraphs

gotchas: Paragraph ranges include the paragraph break character, so setting text on one may merge it with the next (unverified); use InsertBefore / InsertAfter for edits.
Paragraph-level properties (Alignment, ParaSpacingBefore/After, indents) apply to whole paragraphs even when the range covers only part of one.
cards.example:
Set p = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Paragraphs
p.First.Size = 28
p.First.Bold = True
For i = 2 To p.Count
    p.Item(i).Alignment = cdrLeftAlignment
Next i
cards.source: cdr_api_24 agent (VGCoreAuto.tlb harvest; coclass members read from the members_on interface)

cards.name: TextRange
cards.summary: A run of characters in a text object (from Text.Story, Text.Range or the Characters / Words / Lines / Paragraphs collections): read or change its text, font, size, style, colour, spacing, alignment, bullets, drop caps, tabs, OpenType features and text styles.
use_for: setting headline font, size, weight and colour from a script
colouring one keyword in a sentence
inserting or replacing copy while keeping its formatting
switching OpenType features (ligatures, small caps) or applying a named text style
drop caps and bulleted lists in paragraph text
avoid: frame-level settings (columns, vertical alignment, linking): use TextFrame
text in many shapes at once: loop shapes, or use styles so one style edit updates everything
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTextRange. cards.name: TransformMatrix
cards.summary: A 2D affine transformation matrix (d11, d12, d21, d22 plus X / Y translation) with methods to translate, rotate, scale, combine, invert and apply it to points and vectors. Used to read or set a shape's transformation in one step.
use_for: rotating or scaling objects around an exact point with a single transform
reading whether an object has been rotated, mirrored or skewed (packaging and dieline checks)
mapping points between coordinate systems in a custom tool shape
avoid: simple moves and rotations: Shape.Move, Shape.Rotate or Shape.SetPosition are clearer
perspective or envelope distortion: a matrix is affine only (it can skew, see IsSkewedOrRotated, but not taper); use a perspective or envelope effect
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTransformMatrix. Create one with Application.Math (CreateIdentityTransformMatrix, CreateRotationTransformMatrix, CreateScaleTransformMatrix, CreateTranslationTransformMatrix, CreateLineSegmentTransformMatrix); read a shape's own with Shape.TransformationMatrix; apply with Shape.ApplyTransformMatrix or Curve.ApplyTransformMatrix. Angles are believed to be degrees counter-clockwise, as elsewhere in the CorelDRAW API (unverified for this class).

m.BindToDocument ActiveDocument
m.RotateAround 30, ActiveShape.CenterX, ActiveShape.CenterY

cards.name: Transparency
cards.summary: The transparency of one object (Shape.Transparency): none, uniform, fountain (gradient fade), pattern or texture transparency, applied to the fill, outline or both, plus the merge (blend) mode and freezing.
use_for: fading a photo or shape into the background with a linear fountain transparency
semi-transparent overlay panels behind poster text
Multiply / Screen / Overlay blend effects between vector objects
textured or patterned see-through effects
avoid: print jobs for old RIPs or EPS export: transparency is flattened or rasterized on export (unverified per exporter); check the PDF
unattended runs calling UserAssign: it opens a dialog
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTransparency. Reach it with Shape.Transparency. Apply a type with ApplyUniformTransparency, ApplyFountainTransparency, ApplyPatternTransparency or ApplyTextureTransparency (the last three return the fill object to fine-tune); remove with ApplyNoTransparency.

key_members.use: flat transparency value (0-100 by analogy with the fountain defaults, unverified)

key_members.name: ApplyFountainTransparency

cards.name: TreeManager
cards.summary: Low-level access to a document's object tree (Document.TreeManager): a virtual layer for building shapes off-document, new detached group nodes, cleanup of empty or single-child groups, and the selected tree nodes.
use_for: building complex artwork off-page (on the virtual layer) and inserting it in one step
restructuring groups without changing the user's selection
cleaning up empty or one-child groups after an import

cards.name: TreeNode
cards.summary: One node of the document's object tree: the document root, a page, a layer, a group, a link group, a symbol or a shape. It walks the tree (parent, children, siblings), links / unlinks and moves nodes, and swaps node data, without going through the selection.
use_for: moving a shape into an existing group without ungrouping and regrouping
walking every object of a page in stacking order for a preflight report
reordering objects inside a group (MoveToFirst / MoveBefore)
avoid: simple restacking of selected objects: Shape.OrderToFront / OrderBackOne are clearer
cards.how: Coclass; members live on IVGTreeNode. Reach it with Shape.TreeNode, Layer.TreeNode, Page.TreeNode or Spread.TreeNode, or from TreeManager (CreateGroupNode, FirstSelectedNode). Shape gives the real document shape back; Type says what kind of node it is (cdrTreeNodeType).

key_members.name: Type
key_members.use: node kind: shape, group, link group, symbol, root, page, layer

key_members.name: Shape
key_members.use: the real document shape for this node

key_members.name: VirtualShape
key_members.use: a virtual shape for this node

key_members.name: UnLink
key_members.use: take the node out of the tree (not destroyed)

key_members.name: LinkAsChildOf
key_members.use: insert as first child of a node

key_members.name: MoveToFirst

Handle is a unique ID, but not stated to be stable across sessions (unverified); do not store it in files.

Set grp = ActivePage.Shapes.Item("Badge")

n.UnLink
